name: VIX backwardation-armed crypto oversold dip-buy (vol-curve regime gate)
rationale: Thesis: the VIX term-structure SIGN (not level) is a cross-asset capitulation gate. When the curve flips into backwardation (front-month implied vol > longer-dated, i.e. vix_term_slope negative, ~20% of days), it marks acute equity-vol panic that historically precedes positive forward S&P returns (Macrosynergy, Quantpedia, pm-research). Crypto majors are high-beta risk-on and tightly coupled to equity-vol regimes, so a TradFi backwardation reading ARMS a mean-reversion long in crypto; the trigger is a local oversold (rsi). The regime is the arming switch, the oversold is the entry. Edge hedge funds skip: they express the vol-curve view via VIX FUTURES (capacity-rich, well-arbed); using the curve as a FREE cross-asset gate on long-only spot crypto majors is a low-capacity, un-automated cross-domain bridge they ignore because the crypto leg is too small. Low turnover: backwardation is rare AND must coincide with oversold, so this fires seldom — the 10bps taker fee barely bites. Disconfirmer 1 (is it just buy-the-dip?): the same rsi-oversold entry with NO vix_term_slope gate is a separate control spec; if the gated net-of-fee deflated Sharpe is not materially above it, the gate adds nothing and the 'edge' is plain buy-the-dip. Disconfirmer 2 (is backwardation the active ingredient, or any vol reading?): a sibling control takes the identical oversold entry in CONTANGO (positive slope) instead of backwardation; if the contango version is as good or better, the sign carries no information and it is level-in-disguise. Disconfirmer 3 (holdout): the purged+embargoed recent slice must stay positive or it is cycle-position-in-disguise. The Gate disposes; an honest FAIL is a valid outcome.
catalyst: VIX term structure in backwardation (front > back, negative slope) coinciding with a crypto major oversold (low rsi)
